decision.summary: NO_ACTION: no open positions remain, and the hard daily cooldown still blocks any new BTC daily entry today.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. Account state is coherent and shows no open positions, so there is nothing to close or reduce. Trade log shows the May 15 daily thesis position `will-bitcoin-dip-to-80k-on-may-15` Yes was fully closed at 13:08 UTC for `take_profit`. Under the playbook's strict post-win daily cooldown, once any BTC daily REACH/DIP position resolves in our favor or is exited via take-profit on the current UTC day, no additional BTC daily position may be opened until the next UTC day. That hard gate remains in force at 20:00 UTC and overrides any later market setup.
